address: 12G2 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai Street, Sai Gon Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 710000, Vietnam
bio: The soft lighting, minimalist interior and romantic soundtrack make this venue the perfect spot for date nights. The most prized seats are at the counter offering intimate views of the kitchen. Three set menus star modern European recipes jazzed up by a scattering of local produce and seasonings. The must-try duck breast is velvety and juicy, clad in crackling skin as crisp as peanut brittle. Expect sound wine tips from the sommelier....
